UNSAFE USE: direct fixed-index descriptor reads at probe/bind/init (endpoint[k].desc.bEndpointAddress / .wMaxPacketSize) used to program pipes, and wMaxPacketSize used to compute and store per-altsetting max packet sizes (alt_max_pkt_size[]) that later size/limit URB transfer buffers.
